note: Canadia Bank's savings account page: no maintenance fee, a minimum balance of 1 dollar (or 4,000 riels) for a resident and 10 dollars for a non-resident; the Visa or UnionPay debit card's 50 cents a month is the card's and isn't modelled here, nor are dormancy and early-closure charges. ABA Bank's page answers this client with a Cloudflare challenge and wasn't read.

sources.title: Canadia Bank, Savings Account
sources.said: Minimum On-Going Balance For Resident: USD 1 or KHR4,000 ... For Non-Resident: USD10 or equivalent ... Visa/UnionPay Debit Card USD0.50 or equivalent per month ... Dormant Account Fee USD 10 or equivalent
